name: mvp slice bounds — MVP_MAX_SLICES and the exhausted-spec bound each stop re-engagement and tell the owner what he CAN do next (PHASE-56 W-1, R-4/R-19)
description: PHASE-56 W-1. R-4 forbids an unbounded cap across slices; R-19 fixes MVP_MAX_SLICES = 3 as a slice-count bound (ITERATION_CAP stays the sole authority over iterations, untouched at 5) and binds the message: a bound must state the owner's exits, never merely block. Two legs. Leg A: a project already at slice_index = MVP_MAX_SLICES gets refused — no new loop, no status change, no slice appended — with a plain-Arabic message carrying all three declared exits. Leg B: a project whose slice scope has an EMPTY excluded_acceptance_criteria_ids set (everything in the specification is built) is refused the same way with the exhausted-spec message and its own exits. Also asserts MVP_MAX_SLICES is exported as a single named constant and that ITERATION_CAP is untouched at 5.
